question.text: Vindhya Event-Driven Fund buys an INR 1,000 face-value corporate bond (8% annual coupon, annual pay) 120 days after the last coupon date at a clean price of INR 1,010. Using 365-day basis, what is the dirty (invoice) price paid?

explanation.text: The Logic: Accrued interest = Face * Coupon * (Days/365) = 1000 * 0.08 * (120/365) = INR 26.30. Dirty price = Clean price + Accrued interest = 1,010 + 26.30 = INR 1,026.30. The Trap: INR 1,010 is clean (ignores accrued). INR 1,090 adds full year's coupon. INR 1,050 uses 180 days. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C, XV, and X-B test clean vs. dirty price convention. VIII tests within fixed-income derivative legs. Manager's Pro-Tip: For Cat III daily NAV on a coupon-bearing book, mark bonds at clean price + AI accrual at day level - this prevents NAV bumps on coupon-payment days (AI resets to zero while clean price unchanged).
